Hey Javed,

You are hired. Welcome to the team.

Before we go full speed I want to be straight with you about what this role actually requires — because I respect you enough to be honest from the start.

We are asking for **100 approved clips per month.** Not 100 submitted. Approved. I will be strict about the standard because the quality of every clip represents the brand. A clip that does not meet the standard gets sent back — it does not count until it is right.

That is the expectation and it will not change.

But here is my promise to you in return:

I will do everything on my end to make sure you have everything you need to hit that standard. I am recording new in depth videos specifically designed to show you exactly how to build a perfect clip — the pacing, the moment selection, the brand understanding, the editing style, everything. You will not be guessing. You will have full clarity on what we want and how to get there.

Because the goal is bigger than 100 clips. I am training you to become a **Lead Clipper** — someone who understands this brand deeply enough to approve other people's clips, lead a team, and earn up to $2,000 per month. That path starts now.

High standards on both sides. You deliver. I support. Together we build something real.

Contract is coming today or tomorrow. Stay ready.

Cleavon
